messages:
Alex: CI turned red on PR #5234 — only failing test is TestS3Upload in the integration matrix. Can we rerun just that one job without touching the docker image build?
Priya: Yep, you can do a targeted job retry. Use the CI bot command to avoid a full rebuild.
Sam: If it's a flaky test, prefer rerunning the job first. If it fails consistently, then we consider image/rebuild.
Alex: What's the exact command? I don't want to guess and accidentally trigger a full pipeline.
Priya: Use the internal CI helper: `ri ci retry --pr 5234 --job integration:s3-upload --keep-image`
Priya: That tells the orchestration layer to reschedule the job on the same image snapshot (no imagebuild).
infra-bot: Received retry request for PR 5234, job integration:s3-upload. Queued on pool `ci-runner-small`. (run_id: 987654321)
Jordan: Alternative (GitHub Actions): find the run id for the failing job and `gh run rerun 987654321 --workflow "integration.yml" --job "integration:s3-upload"` — GH will only rerun that job if workflow supports it.
Tanya: If you use Buildkite the pattern is `buildkite-agent build upload --job integration:s3-upload --no-builds` (our wrapper sets `--no-image`), but prefer the `ri` command so CI metrics and tagging remain consistent.
Alex: Thanks. infra-bot shows it queued. One quick follow: how do we preserve caches (pip/kv) so the rerun is fast?
Priya: `ri ci retry` defaults to preserving shared cache; to override use `--clear-cache`. For KV cache we set `X-Preserve-KV: true` in the retry metadata (automatically set by `--keep-image`).
Sam: If you suspect a flake pattern, add `?trigger=canary` in the retry metadata so it goes to a smaller pool first. That helps reduce blast radius.
Alex: Good tip. If rerun fails again, should I open a bisect?
Tanya: Yes. If 2/3 reruns fail, file a short bisect request and attach the failing logs + sample seed. We can run a binary search across recent commits with `ri ci bisect --pr 5234 --test TestS3Upload`.
Alex: Perfect. Will rerun, then bisect if it persists. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: One more note — avoid `--keep-image` for infra changes (kernel, glibc) since image rebuild may be necessary.
Priya: Also leave a short note on the PR when you kick the retry (`@ci-bot retried integration:s3-upload`) so reviewers know why CI changed.
Alex: Added comment on the PR. infra-bot updated: run 987654321 succeeded on rerun. Closing this thread. :tada:
